# Electron

Electron is a two-person collaborative movie-night and date-planning site.

## Agent API

- OpenAPI 3.1: /api/agent/v1/openapi.json
- Public catalog: /api/agent/v1/catalog/{movies|places|suggestions}
- Anonymous suggestions: POST /api/agent/v1/suggestions/{movies|places}
- Private reads and household actions require a bearer token.

Public catalog responses are deliberately curated. They do not include messages,
memories, quiz or game state, profile activity, PIN values, or database internals.
Do not infer permission to access private data from this file or robots.txt.

Authenticated requests use a shared household credential and declare Aaron or
Electra as the actor. That attribution is caller-declared. Delete and PIN actions
must be previewed and explicitly confirmed with the short-lived token returned by
the API. Never ask a user to reveal a PIN or bearer token in conversation.
